meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 它把一份文档交给 NotebookLM,生成一份 kawaii 角色风格的幻灯片 PDF,默认存为源文件同目录的 <名字>-slides.pdf。若配好相关环境变量,还会上传换成手机竖版分享链接。
howto.when: 当你提到「Wowerpoint this」「make a deck about <文件>」「把这份报告做成幻灯片」等说法时接管。若源文档不存在或太单薄,它会先写一份。

say.note: 生成 kawaii 风格幻灯片 PDF

say.text: 把这份报告做成幻灯片,标题用它的 H1
say.note: H1 或文件名会作为标题

say.text: 这个文件做幻灯片,提示词改成:用小动物讲故事
say.note: 自定义生成提示词,原样透传

howto.what_en: It hands one document to NotebookLM and produces a kawaii-character slide-deck PDF, saved next to the source as <stem>-slides.pdf. If the WOWerpoint env vars are set, it also uploads it for a 9:16 mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", and similar. If the source doc is missing or too thin, it writes one first.

say_en.text: Turn this report into slides, titled with its H1
say_en.note: H1 or filename becomes the title

say_en.text: Make slides from this file with prompt: tell it with animals
say_en.note: Your prompt is passed through verbatim
